rules.name: ouat178-dev-wp-state
rules.sql: SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, product_code, primary_code, secondary_code, primary_multiplier, secondary_multiplier, created_by, created_timestamp FROM opera.correl_product_mapping ORDER BY business_unit, product_code

SELECT business_unit, derivative_type, status, count(*) AS securities, min(maturity_date) AS min_maturity, max(maturity_date) AS max_maturity FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

SELECT 'settlement_price_table_wp' AS tbl, business_unit, count(*) AS row_count, max(created_timestamp) AS last_built FROM opera.settlement_price_table_wp GROUP BY business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'underlying_price_table_wp', business_unit, count(*), max(created_timestamp) FROM opera.underlying_price_table_wp GROUP BY business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'recon_scicom_correlation_input', business_unit, count(*), max(created_timestamp) FROM opera.recon_scicom_correlation_input GROUP BY business_unit

SELECT business_unit, value_date, security_id, settle_price, settle_delta_1, settle_delta_2, settle_vega_1, created_timestamp AS written_utc FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table s WHERE security_id LIKE 'CM WP%' AND value_date = (SELECT max(value_date) FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table x WHERE x.business_unit = s.business_unit AND x.security_id LIKE 'CM WP%') ORDER BY business_unit, security_id LIMIT 40
